description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeAtWorkService class, which provides functionalities to handle employee work time data, including calculating total hours worked, retrieving last punch actions, and generating weekly summaries within the OrangeHRM HR system.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to calculate and retrieve employee work time data, including weekly and daily summaries, last punch actions, and user details, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getTimeAtWorkResults
methods.description: Retrieves weekly time data and metadata for a specific employee based on the current and spot DateTime.

methods.name: getTimeAtWorkMetaData
methods.description: Generates metadata including last action details, current day/time, weekly range, and total work time for the employee.

methods.name: getDateDetails
methods.description: Returns formatted date and label for a given DateTime object.

methods.name: getTimeInHoursAndMinutes
methods.description: Converts total minutes into hours and minutes.

methods.name: getLastActionDetails
methods.description: Fetches the last punch in/out record and constructs detailed action info for an employee.

methods.name: getTotalTimeForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates total work time in minutes for an employee on a specific date, accounting for punch in/out records.

methods.name: getDataForCurrentWeek
methods.description: Compiles daily work times for each day in the current week for an employee.

methods.name: getTimeDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference in minutes between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: getDateTimeInUTC
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to UTC timezone.

methods.name: getCurrentUserData
methods.description: Retrieves personal user details for an employee.

methods.name: getWeekStartDateIndex
methods.description: Returns the start date index of the week, with caching.
